passage: Europe PMC full text PMC124442 (tool summary): genes selected on the whole data, then the error estimated by cross-validation; the correction is cross-validation external to the selection. SOURCES_D gives the same passage.
faulty: All 72 samples rank genes by absolute two-sample t-statistic; the top 20 are kept; 10-fold cross-validation of a nearest-centroid classifier on those 20 genes runs on all samples; AUC of the pooled held-out scores (difference of distances to the two centroids) is the statistic. Claim holds when AUC >= 0.90.
fixed: In each fold, genes are ranked and the top 20 chosen using the training samples only; centroids from those; AUC on the pooled held-out scores.
estimand: Faulty: AUC of a rule whose genes were chosen with the test samples' labels. Fixed: AUC of the whole procedure on new samples.
model_family: t-ranking, top 20 genes, nearest-centroid classifier. Chosen by me: simple and cheap; the source's own are SVM-RFE and Fisher LDA, which are costlier at 7129 genes.
sizes_note: Source sizes (leukaemia data): 72 samples (47 ALL, 25 AML) x 7129 genes (Europe PMC text as extracted by a tool). I use 72 x 2000 = 144k values because 7129 genes exceeds the 2000-unit axis limit; the sample count is the source's. Reported: for Fisher selection on leukaemia the uncorrected error was 0% at 3 genes against about 5% corrected; the full-sample SVM bias was 2-3% on leukaemia and 10-15% on colon, so the bias is larger for the data set with the harder classes.
exploited_structure: Thousands of genes for tens of samples, so ranking genes on all labels picks genes that separate the classes by chance in the test samples too.

structure_statistic.note_value_source: set by the brief: the statistic is genes/samples, so its value at the brief's sizes is 2000/72 = 27.78. (The source's own setting, 7129 genes and 72 samples per Europe PMC text of PMC124442, would give 99.0 but cannot occur at the brief's sizes.)

notes: Reserve for AMB02 L1.3. Classification stays (the source reports error rates only; earlier evaluation used the same combination). Differs from B2B-06 in statistic (AUC vs error), sizes (72 x 7129 vs 62 x 2000), selected gene count and classifier.
